subject.title: Session Routing Bugs: CLI routing to wrong session, WeChat ID inconsistency, and session deadlock from message flooding

question: Should this broad report remain the umbrella, or should maintainers split it into focused sessions_send routing, TUI default-session, session-activity sorting, WeChat lineage, and background-event isolation items?
rationale: The current source proves multiple unresolved surfaces, but the remaining fix shape crosses core session semantics, Gateway RPC/API behavior, external WeChat plugin ownership, and product policy for internal event isolation.

options.title: Split into focused tracks
options.body: Route the sessions_send and session-activity parts to their focused open issues, then create or update narrow follow-ups for TUI default sessions and live WeChat/background-event proof.

options.title: Keep umbrella open
options.body: Use this issue as the coordination item, but block automated fix work until maintainers assign owners and expected behavior for each sub-bug.

options.title: Close only after linked fixes land
options.body: Close this issue only after focused issues or merged PRs preserve all four reported behaviors with current-main proof.

recommendation.title: Split into focused tracks
recommendation.body: Route the sessions_send and session-activity parts to their focused open issues, then create or update narrow follow-ups for TUI default sessions and live WeChat/background-event proof.
